cif_001_e2_c08_conclusion: Automated pass retained; the original false-positive suspicion is not confirmed under the literal criterion wording.
inferential_limitations: The sample is post-result, deterministic, and enriched for route disagreements and extremes; it is not a simple random sample.
The secondary reviewer is the same model family used by the automated Judge, so correlated error is possible.
Zero observed disagreements does not prove zero error outside the inspected sample.
No independent human adjudication or official ComplexConstraints scorer was run.
claim_boundary: This audit supports internal consistency on 56 selected criterion judgments only. It is not a validated accuracy estimate for the full Judge ledger.
